$Comment: Percent chance a placement continuing a straight run is not used up, in whole percent points: the third block or later placed one step on along the line of the two before it. Added to BuildThrift by the thrift step on such a placement alone, never in the seconds after one (BuildThrift_Flow pays there, and BuildThrift_Shaped on either). Any item's StatModifiers raise it like any stat, and so does an effect's RawStatModifiers. Base 0; Min is a generous negative so a subtractive modifier never clamps.
